mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_points_log (user_id, change_type, change_points, balance_after, ref_type, ref_id, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeType}, #{changePoints}, #{balanceAfter}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, SUM(change_points) AS score FROM user_points_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND change_type = 1 AND change_points > 0 AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day FROM user_points_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND change_type = 1 AND change_points > 0 AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY day ASC
